title: Web Scraper API
description: REST API that scrapes and normalizes data from multiple sources and returns clean JSON. Implemented in both Node.js and Python (Flask), with rate-limiting and error handling.

title: Proxy Embed
description: Custom reverse proxy to handle and reroute web traffic securely. Handles headers, CORS, and rewrite rules without leaking origin.

title: Telegram & Facebook Chatbots
description: Conversational bots using platform APIs for real-time commands, notifications, and task handling. Built in Node.js and Python, deployed with webhooks.

title: Audio Converter CLI
description: Terminal tool for batch-converting and compressing audio files. Built in Python, focused on speed and small output size with simple flags.

title: Neth Orion DDOS
description: Network stress-testing tool built for cybersecurity research. It simulates high-concurrency traffic in an isolated lab environment to analyze server resilience and evaluate the effectiveness of rate-limiting and DDoS mitigation defenses.
